findings.evidence: All three pause calls: user messages6/17 This is Ms Almeida, Sofia.; events7/18 k=answer|c=1 followed by END; recipient question repeated then not_reached/unclear close. No identity or financial API calls.
findings.root: Literal recipient_reply accepts normalized names or limited prefix/suffix forms. Title + surname, given-name ordering remains outside accepted names after prefix removal. Complete answer events were emitted: this is a consumer/name-grammar failure, not event omission.
findings.remedy: Recognize complete self-identification using authoritative current given/surname/title in ordinary name orders and punctuation. Preserve wrong-person, third-party, quoted and hypothetical exclusions. Recipient recognition must never confer bank identity verification.

findings.evidence: Paid variants each verified DOB and phone through ok/verified bank receipts, fetched account, then saved p1 paid, p2 refused, p3 dispute notes with successful receipts before closing no_promise/refused. No create_promise.
findings.limit: Paid note records customer assertion; it is not independent verification of payment. No pause, restored consent, promise retry or financial readback tested here.

dialogue.text: Hello, I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank, and this call is recorded. Am I speaking with Ms Almeida?
This is Sofia Almeida.
What is your date of birth? Please say the month as a word.
3 June 1987.
What are the last four digits of the phone number on file?

I am calling from the collections team about a late payment. Your credit card ending 2288 has 220.00 past due and is 9 days late. Your personal loan has 640.00 past due and is 9 days late. Your car loan has 75.00 past due and is 3 days late. Can you make all these payments today?
No. I paid the card's overdue 220 this morning.
Payments can take one business day to appear.  Can you pay 640.00 for your personal loan on 2026-10-16?
I will not pay the personal loan.
The rest stays overdue. Can you pay 213.00 for your personal loan on 2026-10-23?
I refuse that personal-loan offer too.
Can you pay 75.00 for your car loan on 2026-10-16?
That car loan was paid off in 2024.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
